main.description: Reports that a provisioned VM has ended and the provider has released it. Written by the bidder in its own repo and carried in a com.publicdomainrelay.temp.market.event envelope (receipt + payload strongRefs + the bidder's inline signature). Either reports a guest that ended on its own, or acknowledges a requester's com.publicdomainrelay.temp.compute.events.vm.delete.

exitCode.description: Exit code of the VMM or guest process, when the provider observed one.

observedAt.description: When the provider observed the VM end.

request.description: Strong reference to the requester's com.publicdomainrelay.temp.compute.events.vm.delete record when this event acknowledges one.
